lead: An `[until: gone <path>:<needle>]` needle that spans a wrapped line retires itself the first time `session.py --wrap` runs.
body: The needle is a plain substring of the file, so a sentence broken across a Rust string continuation or a `///` wrap holds it nowhere, and the bullet is deleted with a message stating the file no longer holds a sentence it plainly still does. Grep the needle before writing the trailer, and shorten it to the longest run that sits on one line.

until.arg: tools/playbook.py:A needle is a plain substring
